trial_title: Homocysteine Lowering and Atherosclerosis Reduction Trial (HART)
brief_summary:
Study Objective:

1\. To evaluate whether combined therapy with folic acid 2.5 mg/day, vitamin B6 50 mg/day and vitamin B12 1000 micrograms/day vs placebo reduces the rate of atherosclerosis progression, as evaluated by quantitative B-mode carotid ultrasound (US).

eligibility_table.criterion: Women and Men aged ≥ 55 years at high risk for CV events
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a serum homocysteine level ≥15 µmol/L?

eligibility_table.criterion: Documented (CAD): i) History of prior MI; ii) stable or unstable angina with documented multivessel CAD or strongly positive stress test; iii) Multivessel CAD and PTCA ≥ 6 months prior to randomization; iv) multivessel CABG ≥ 4 years prior to randomization; v) Multivessel CAD on angiography
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) and underwent Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG) which qualifies as multivessel CABG performed more than 4 years prior to randomization.

eligibility_table.criterion: Documented peripheral vascular disease (PVD): i) Previous limp bypass surgery and/or previous peripheral percutaneous transluminal angioplasty and/or previous limp or foot amputation due to PVD. ii) History of intermittent claudication with ankle/arm blood pressure ratio of ≤ 0.80 or with significant arterial stenosis on angiography
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has moderate to severe Peripheral Vascular Disease (PVD) and has a history of significant bilateral carotid stenosis, which indicates documented PVD.

eligibility_table.criterion: Documented cerebrovascular disease: i) History of previous ischemic stroke
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of a prior cerebrovascular accident (CVA), which qualifies as documented cerebrovascular disease.

eligibility_table.criterion: Diabetes mellitus with ≥ 1 additional major CV risk factor(s)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Diabetes Mellitus Type II (DMII) and also has multiple additional cardiovascular risk factors including CAD, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient provided informed consent for participation in the Homocysteine Lowering and Atherosclerosis Reduction Trial (HART) as documented in the trial records?
Has the patient undergone a carotid ultrasound examination within the last 12 months that shows adequate imaging quality to assess for carotid artery stenosis?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current use of folic acid supplements > 200 mg/day
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently taking folic acid supplements at a dosage greater than 200 mg/day?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known previous adverse reactions to folic acid, Vitamin B6 or B12
eligibility_table.justification: There is no documented history of adverse reactions to folic acid, Vitamin B6, or B12 in the provided profile, but the absence of information leads to a conservative NEI verdict.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any adverse reactions to folic acid, Vitamin B6, or B12 in the past?

eligibility_table.criterion: Planned cardiac, peripheral or cerebrovascular procedures
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a complex medical history, but there is no explicit mention of planned cardiac, peripheral, or cerebrovascular procedures, leading to a conservative NEI verdict.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone any planned cardiac, peripheral, or cerebrovascular procedures within the last 12 months?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Current use of folic acid supplements > 200 mg/day
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Known previous adverse reactions to folic acid, Vitamin B6 or B12
